newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GOV SAYS TO KEEP 98 SPENDING WITHIN FRAMES.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GOV SAYS TO KEEP 98 SPENDING WITHIN FRAMES.

text.p: The government said in a statement on Monday it had agreed to keep spending in the 1998 state budget within the frames set in February.

"The budget for next year will be made in accordance with the budgetary framework agreed upon in February," the government said after a meeting aimed at reviewing the progress in preparatory work on the 1998 budget.
The government concluded that the unchanged economic outlook did not warrant any major changes in the 1998 budget plans or medium term fiscal policy, it said.
In February, the five-party left-right-green government decided that 1998 budget spending must not exceed 191 billion markka compared to 190.3 billion this year.
The 1998 state budget deficit has been projected at 20 billion markka, down from 26 billion this year.
